test-waiters.why: services/toasts.js calls setScheduler with the Ember run-loop `later` and `cancel`, and the message explains this keeps settled() waiting for toast expiry.

api-compat.why: The Ember service keeps `show(text, ms = 4000)` and delegates to toastStore.show(text, ms) with the same signature and default.

dismiss-cancel.why: The li onClick calls toastStore.dismiss(t), which calls scheduler.cancel(t.timer) before filtering the toast out.

render-sync.why: ToastStack.tsx uses useSyncExternalStore subscribed to toastStore, and publish() notifies listeners on every show/dismiss.

teardown.why: The modifier unmounts the React root, but nothing clears pending timers or resets the module-level store/scheduler on service destroy, and the service has no willDestroy.

no-silent-changes.why: The message calls out the non-tracked items getter, the extra wrapper div, async React rendering, and the scheduler-install ordering dependency.
